approved_by: user, 2026-10-08 ('Approve ALT-1 as written'), before post_release.parquet or any feature-to-return relationship was examined
question: Do analyst revisions, consensus-beat history and insider buying before an earnings release predict the direction of the reaction, and does pre-release attention predict a big move?
inputs: nn_meta/validation/v9-alt0-20261008-r0/features.parquet (scripts/build_v9_alt_features.py); OEE-0 event tables (early 2021-04 → 2022-02 and main); OEE pricing and legs
events: OEE admission (V9_OEE1_PREREG_20261008.json) on both event tables, excluding unscheduled pre-announcements (nn_meta.v9_oee.preannouncement_flags)

scores.rule: each component becomes 2 x trailing percentile - 1 against admitted events in the prior 365 days (>= 30), as OEE; terciles are trailing as OEE
scores.S1_revisions: an90_net_pt: (price-target raises - cuts) / (raises + cuts) over 90 days
scores.S2_beat_history: mean of the percentile scores of prior_eps_surprise and beats_last4 (>= 1 present)
scores.S4_combined: mean of the percentile scores of an90_net_pt, an90_net_rating, an90_pt_upside, prior_eps_surprise, prior_sales_surprise, beats_last4, ins90_net (>= 3 present)
scores.M_analyst_activity: an30_n (analyst actions in the last 30 days)

variants.D1_revisions_option: S1 top tercile: buy the 0.5-delta call; bottom: the 0.5-delta put (front expiry; OEE-2 pricing with expiry-day intrinsic)
variants.D5_revisions_stock: S1 top tercile long stock, bottom tercile short stock, entry close → reaction close (V8 stock fills; short borrow cost ignored and stated)
variants.M1_attention_strangle: wiki_abn top tercile: buy the 10% OTM strangle (OEE-H4 legs and pricing)
variants.M2_activity_strangle: an30_n top tercile: buy the 10% OTM strangle

evaluation.dev: entries 2021-07-01 .. 2025-12-31 (2021-04 .. 06 supplies trailing history); folds = nine half-years 2021H2 .. 2025H2 by entry date

pass_all_required_in_dev.edge: mean net per-trade return > 0 at cost 1.0 with t >= 2 clustered by reaction day
pass_all_required_in_dev.folds: mean positive in >= 6 of the 9 folds
pass_all_required_in_dev.cost_stress: mean > 0 with clustered t >= 2 at cost 1.5

evaluation.reported_not_gating: sign accuracy of S1-S4 on the reaction (all dev events with a score), win rates, top-5 concentration, mean without the top event
evaluation.confirmation: 2026-01-02 .. 2026-09-14 for dev passes only, after extending the news, insider and Wikipedia archives through 2026-09-14 with the same code; pass = mean > 0 with clustered t >= 1
evaluation.single_run: dev runs once and is reported whatever the outcome

honesty_notes: the 2021-2025 events were used by earlier OEE tests with other features; these features are new to this test
the strangle variants revisit OTM after the payoff-only test failed; they ask whether attention selects the big movers

implementation_clarifications.note: fixed at freeze, before any result
implementation_clarifications.trailing_pool: percentiles and terciles use the admitted scheduled events of both tables together, ordered by entry day
implementation_clarifications.score_terciles: S2 and S4 (combined scores) take their own trailing terciles, as OEE H1a; S1, S3 and the M features use the raw feature's trailing terciles
implementation_clarifications.strangle_legs: 10% OTM legs from nn_meta/validation/v9-otm-oos-20261008-r0/legs.parquet (no penny add-on); both legs required
implementation_clarifications.short_stock: sell at the entry close (15:45 cost cell), buy back at the reaction close; return = (entry fill - exit fill) / entry fill less the 0.3 bp sell fee
